title: Test Order Pollution via Shared Module-Level Cache
root_cause: Module-level _rate_config_cache dict persists between tests. test_override_premium_rate mutates it, polluting state for test_read_default_rate when execution order is shuffled.

naive_quick_fix.description: Inlines _rate_config_cache.clear() at the start of test_read_default_rate. Brittle — doesn't protect new tests.

certified_real_fix.description: Adds autouse pytest fixture calling reset_config() before and after each test. Guarantees clean state regardless of order.
